title: When the Spire Wakes Anew
premise: Ivo Amberdale has spent twenty-two years in Hollowmere, a valley warded against magic, hiding the beast-speech that would see them burned elsewhere. When the old gods stir and the valley's ward cracks, Ivo is dragged out by a dying god's plea: their sister's soul was sold to the court beneath the mountain to buy the valley's peace, and now the usurper Veyra marches on the free cities to harvest what remains. Guided by a cynical ex-knight and a fox who is more than a fox, Ivo must bargain with, betray, and finally defy the mountain court. In the end Ivo wins back the soul at the cost of their own voice — trading beast-speech forever — and chooses truth over safety, returning to a valley that can no longer hide anyone.
about_author: Jude Galloway is the pen name of a former shepherd turned archivist who claims to have learned storytelling from livestock and library dust alike. They live somewhere with poor phone reception and write about people who talk to things that shouldn't answer.

chapters.title: The Valley That Forgets
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Establishes Hollowmere's quiet: Ivo secretly speaks with goats and crows, hiding it even from family. A crow arrives speaking words no bird should know — 'the spire wakes.' Emotional beat: the dread of being known.

chapters.title: Wardlight Failing
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The valley's ancient ward flickers visibly for the first time in generations; the elders blame weather. Ivo's grandmother dies whispering an apology to someone named Sera. Beat: grief braided with suspicion.

chapters.title: What Grandmother Sold
chapters.summary: Ivo finds a contract hidden in her loom — a soul given to 'the court beneath' in exchange for the ward. The name on it is Sera Amberdale, a sister Ivo never knew existed. Beat: inheritance as wound.

chapters.title: The Fox at the Ford
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Leaving the valley for the first time, Ivo meets Nettle, a talking fox who claims to serve no one and knows too much. First taste of raw magic outside the ward — overwhelming, beautiful, dangerous. Beat: vertigo of freedom.

chapters.title: A Knight Without a Banner
chapters.summary: Nettle's POV (first shift). The fox recruits Ser Aldric, a disgraced knight drinking in a border town, by blackmail and flattery. Aldric recognizes what Ivo is and says nothing. Beat: reluctant alliance forming.

chapters.title: Roads Full of Refugees
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The free cities are flooding with displaced folk; usurper Veyra's armies burn villages where gods still answer prayers. Ivo heals a dying horse with beast-speech before witnesses. Beat: the secret costs more than silence.

chapters.title: The God in the Well
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. In a ruined shrine, a minor god — small as a coin, drowning in its own well — begs Ivo to carry its last prayer to the mountain court. It offers a map written in dreams. Beat: pity for the divine.

chapters.title: Veyra's Harvest
chapters.summary: Aldric's POV. Flashback chapters within: how Veyra rose by devouring gods' names, and why Aldric once served her. He confesses he signed the order that emptied Hollowmere's sister-village. Beat: guilt seeking penance.

chapters.title: The Toll of Names
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. At a checkpoint, Veyra's nametakers strip travelers of their true names; Ivo barely escapes by giving a false one, feeling something tear loose anyway. Beat: identity under assault.

chapters.title: City of Bells That Lie
chapters.summary: Nettle's POV. The free city of Corvane: politics, informants, a black market in bottled prayers. The trio learns the mountain court trades in souls openly — and that Sera's soul is its crown jewel. Beat: hope sharpened into purpose.

chapters.title: The Broker of Small Mercies
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. A soul-broker offers passage beneath the mountain in exchange for one year of Ivo's memories. Aldric argues to refuse; Ivo secretly considers paying. Beat: loyalty vs. truth begins to bite.

chapters.title: Nettle's Bargain
chapters.summary: Nettle's POV. Revealed: Nettle was once human, a courtier of the mountain court, transformed for treachery. He offers the broker his own name to cover Ivo's debt. Beat: friendship priced honestly.

chapters.title: Descent
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The three enter the mountain through a dead god's throat. The court beneath is lit by captive souls like lanterns; Ivo hears Sera's voice among them. Beat: awe curdling to horror.

chapters.title: The Court Beneath
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Audience with the Pale Regent, who reveals the truth: Hollowmere's ward runs on Sera's suffering, renewed each generation. Grandmother didn't sell a soul — she sold a daughter to save a town. Beat: the ground of Ivo's life gives way.

chapters.title: Sister, Lantern
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo reaches Sera's soul-lantern; she has been aware for decades, singing herself sane. She doesn't want rescue if it means Hollowmere falls. Beat: love demanding an impossible choice.

chapters.title: The Usurper Arrives
chapters.summary: Aldric's POV. Veyra's army reaches the mountain; she intends to consume the entire court and every soul in it. Chaos in the deep halls; the trio flees deeper rather than out. Beat: all plans burn.

chapters.title: Prayer Answered Wrong
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Trapped, Ivo uses the drowned god's dream-map to reach the court's heart — the first spire, root of all wards. There they find the old gods, diminished, waiting for someone willing to pay. Beat: the price made explicit.

chapters.title: The Price of Survival
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. To free Sera and shatter Veyra's claim, the gods require a living voice freely given — Ivo's gift itself. Ivo accepts, speaking one last command to every creature in the mountain: rise. Beat: sacrifice as climax.

chapters.title: When the Spire Wakes
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs interwoven. The spire wakes; souls pour free; beasts and freed gods turn on Veyra's host. Aldric holds the gate so Ivo and Sera can climb; Nettle carries Ivo when their legs fail. Beat: catharsis through chaos.

chapters.title: Ash and Aftermath
chapters.summary: Aldric's POV. Veyra, unmade mid-harvest, dissolves into nameless wind. Aldric survives, unburdened but purposeless; Nettle, name restored, chooses to remain a fox. Beat: survivors taking stock.

chapters.title: Homecoming, Unwarded
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo returns to Hollowmere with Sera reborn in flesh. The ward is gone; magic enters the valley; some neighbors welcome it, others flee. Ivo cannot speak to animals anymore — the goats look at them like strangers. Beat: bittersweet return.

chapters.title: The Voice That Remains
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV, closing. Ivo takes up the drowned god's shrine, rebuilding it as a place where small gods can rest safely. Sera plants a garden over the old loom-house. A crow lands nearby and says nothing — and Ivo, finally, is content to be only human. Beat: peace earned, not granted.
